description: This file defines the command handler for the '/compact' command in an auto-reply system, including functions for extracting instructions, determining skip reasons, formatting reasons, and executing the command logic with session management and system event logging.

methods.name: extractCompactInstructions
methods.description: Extracts compact instructions from the command message, handling prefixes and structural mentions.

methods.name: isCompactionSkipReason
methods.description: Determines if a given reason indicates that compaction should be skipped.

methods.name: formatCompactionReason
methods.description: Formats a reason string into a user-friendly message.
